Mazo de Fuego que arma jugadas largas a: FIRE deck that builds long plays from the Snake-Eye monsters.
Mazo de Trampas con demonios que se acti: Trap deck with fiends that activate on your opponent's turn. It wins through card advantage and board control.

Mazo de monstruos Wyrm con Sincro, de co: Wyrm monster combo deck with Synchro.

Carta de mano: la descartás para negar u: Hand trap: discard it to negate a search from the Deck, a Special Summon from the Deck, or a send to the GY from the Deck.
Carta de mano: negás el efecto de un mon: Hand trap: negate a monster's effect on your opponent's turn. Widely used to stop a key monster.
Carta de mano que se puede activar en cu: Hand trap you can activate on any turn: for the rest of the turn, every time your opponent Special Summons, you draw a card. Punishes combo decks.
Carta de mano: si tu rival busca en el D: Hand trap: if your opponent searches the Deck, they can't draw or search any more that turn. Stops long combos.
Carta de mano: si tu rival invoca 5 o má: Hand trap: if your opponent Summons 5 or more monsters in a turn, all face-up monsters on the field (on both sides) are tributed and your opponent is left with a token. Good for punishing big boards.
Hechizo rápido: destierra un monstruo de: Quick-Play Spell: banish a monster from your opponent's GY and negate the effects of that monster and its copies until the end of the next turn.
Trampa que niega los efectos de un monst: Trap that negates the effects of a face-up monster your opponent controls until end of turn. If it was Set face-down, it also negates the other Spells and Traps in that column.
Hechizo que roba cartas: destierra algun: Draw Spell: banish some cards from your Extra Deck, look at cards in your Deck and add one to your hand.
Hechizo que destierra 10 cartas del Deck: Spell that banishes 10 cards from the Deck to draw 2. Fast draw in exchange for cards.
Hechizo que destruye todos los monstruos: Spell that destroys all of your opponent's monsters. Very strong against full boards.
Hechizo que niega los efectos de todos l: Spell that negates the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls for the turn, and you take no damage that turn.
Hechizo rápido: mandás cartas de tu mano: Quick-Play Spell: send cards from your hand or field to the GY and, for each one, choose an Effect Monster your opponent controls: it loses half its ATK and its effects are negated that turn.
Hechizo que se activa si el rival usó un: Spell that activates if your opponent used a monster effect during your Main Phase. Choose between drawing 2, taking control of an opponent's monster until the end of the turn, or looking at their hand and returning a card to the Deck.
Hechizo que destruye todos los Hechizos: Spell that destroys all of your opponent's Spells and Traps.
Trampa que, al final de tu Fase de Batal: Trap that, at the end of your Battle Phase, banishes cards from your opponent's field until they have the same number as you. If you control no cards, it can be activated from your hand.
Trampa que declara un tipo de monstruo (: Trap that declares a monster type (Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz or Pendulum): that turn nobody can Special Summon that type, and the effects of those already on the field are negated.
Trampa que niega una invocación o una ca: Trap that negates a Summon or a Spell card by paying half your LP.
Trampa continua que niega Hechizos mient: Continuous Trap that negates Spells as long as you keep it by paying 700 LP on each of your turns.
Carta de mano: si no controlás cartas, l: Hand trap: if you control no cards, discard it and draw each time your opponent Summons from the Deck or the Extra Deck.
Hechizo rápido que destierra una carta d: Quick-Play Spell that banishes a card your opponent controls without activating it, by paying 1000 LP.
Hechizo que destruye todos los monstruos: Spell that destroys all monsters on the field, both yours and your opponent's.
Hechizo rápido que destruye una carta de: Quick-Play Spell that destroys a Spell or Trap card on the field.
Hechizo clásico: robás 2 cartas. Es el e: Classic Spell: draw 2 cards. The basic example of "draw" (it's Forbidden in the TCG).
El monstruo clásico de Kaiba: 3000 de AT: Kaiba's classic monster: 3000 ATK and 2500 DEF, Level 8. Seen a lot in Blue-Eyes decks.
El monstruo clásico de Yugi: 2500 de ATK: Yugi's classic monster: 2500 ATK and 2100 DEF, Level 7. A pillar of the Dark Magician deck.
Las cartas que tenés en la mano. Hasta 6: The cards you hold in your hand. Up to 6 at the end of your turn; if you have more, you discard.
Zona donde van las cartas destruidas, us: Zone where destroyed, used or discarded cards go. Many effects use the GY as a resource.
Sacar una carta del juego de forma que n: Removing a card from play so it doesn't go to the GY. Much more permanent than destroying.
Carta de monstruo que se activa desde la: Monster card that activates from the hand during your opponent's turn, like Ash Blossom or Effect Veiler.
Hacer que un efecto o una invocación no: Making an effect or a Summon have no effect. Usually done by responding to the activation.
Efecto que se puede activar en el turno: Effect that can be activated on your opponent's turn or within a chain, not only in your own Main Phase.
Monstruo especial necesario para invocar: Special monster needed to Summon Synchros: it adds up with other monsters and together they make the Synchro's Level.
Mazo de hasta 15 cartas con monstruos de: Deck of up to 15 cards with Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link monsters. You don't draw from it: you Summon from it using materials.
El monstruo principal de un mazo, el que: A deck's main monster, the one you want left on the field at the end of your play.
Carta que se usa en muchos mazos distint: A card used in many different decks, regardless of archetype.
Conjunto de cartas que se agrega a un ma: A package of cards added to a deck to give it an extra function, like drawing or searching.
Carta que cambia las reglas durante todo: Card that changes the rules for the whole turn and limits what your opponent can do.
Hasta 15 cartas que podés cambiar entre: Up to 15 cards you can swap between games of the same match to adapt to your opponent.
Los mazos más jugados y fuertes del mome: The most played and strongest decks of the moment; what you can expect to face in a tournament.
Mazo Sincro de Spellcasters hecho para l: Spellcaster Synchro deck built around the center Monster Zone: Lucina, Fortuna and Tinia Summon from the hand straight to that zone and search the rest from there. Elfnote Regina Summons from the hand on your opponent's turn (quick effect) by sending another Elfnote to the GY, and the deck's Synchros (Seraphim Strelitzia, June Pride) work best standing in the center.
Lucina al centro busca a Regina; Regina: Lucina in the center searches Regina; Regina comes in sending Lucina to the GY and Summons another Elfnote; with a Tuner (Power Patron) and a non-Tuner you make the Synchro. From a single card you build a board with several quick effects.
Depende de la zona central: si el rival: It depends on the center zone: if your opponent occupies it or gives you tokens (for example Orcust) or blocks zones (Kashtira), the deck jams. Hand traps that stop Lucina cut the play short.
Mazo Sincro compuesto casi solo por Tune: Synchro deck made almost entirely of Tuners. Its monsters can use a Tuner from the hand as Synchro Material from the field, and many Hand traps (Ash, Effect Veiler, Ghost Belle) are Tuners, so they can be used as both interruption and material.
Se empieza invocando un Kewl Tune, que u: You start by Summoning a Kewl Tune, which uses a Tuner from the hand to Synchro Summon the next one. Kewl Tune Cue (manipulates your opponent's draw) and Rotary (gives you information about their hand) provide control; Track Maker searches and works as a combo piece.
Va muy mal yendo segundo si no podés fre: It does very badly going second if you can't stop your opponent: competitive lists usually play 15 or more Hand traps. It loses to cards that stop Synchro Summons.
Mazo de monstruos Trueno de Tierra (set: EARTH Thunder monster deck (Chaos Origin set, 2026) that destroys cards and Summons from the hand, with Continuous Traps that give it resources.
Surge Blitzclique se muestra desde la ma: Surge Blitzclique is revealed from the hand to destroy a monster and Summon a Thunder from the hand; if a card is destroyed by an effect while Surge is on the field, it searches another Blitzclique from the Deck. Whisker Blitzclique (Level 8) Summons up to 3 Thunders from the hand and can destroy cards on the field.
